title: Admission Assistant, Founder's College
description:
Position Overview

The Founder’s College Admission Assistant reports to the Associate
Director for Admission for Founder’s College at Butler University.
Serves as the primary point of contact for current Founder’s
College students with in-person services and for Founder’s College
prospective students and their families with respect to campus
visits and events and admission process support. Role serves as the
primary contact role for front desk operations.

This individual works collaboratively with the Admission Assistant
for the Visit Experience based in the Undergraduate Admission
Office as they both coordinate and plan daily admission visits and
group visits with respect to audience. As the administrative visit
support for Founder’s College, this individual responds to inbox
requests, phone calls for visits, inquiries from campus
constituents regarding visit schedules and execution, runs regular
SLATE CRM queries for daily visit itineraries, and manages daily
check-ins. This person works with the Assistant Director of
Admission in hiring Butler Student Ambassadors specific to
Founder’s College as tour guides; trains and schedules the guides
for tours, student panels, special events, and overall recruitment
support.

Responsibilities

Serves as the front desk coordinator and first contact for
Founder’s College

Monitors web-based ticket system via Salesforce

Provides general administrative support including calendar
support, mail distribution, and website copy updates as
needed

Responsible for all Founder’s College daily visits incoming and
outgoing communication via Founder’s College phone line and email
inbox

Prints and manage all itineraries and schedules for Founder’s
College daily visitors

Serve as main point of contact with on-campus constituents
(faculty, staff) for inquiries related to Founder’s College student
visits

Supervises and established schedules for front desk student
support via Butler Student Ambassador program including tour
guides, student panelists, etc.

Coordinates sponsored group visit requests, in coordination
with the Associate Director of Admission for Founder’s College and
the Admission Assistant with the Visit and Events Team.

May be asked to assist with Information Session as needed

Assists with application processing functions in support of
students and in conjunction with colleagues in Enrollment Systems
and Operations and the Office of Financial Aid

Other duties as assigned


Required Qualifications

Associate’s degree
Minimum 1-2 years of experience working in higher education,
preferably in college admissions or a related field
Experience working with historically underrepresented
students.
Strong organization and time management skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the
ability to engage diverse audiences and build relationships with
stakeholders
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Knowledge of the Indianapolis community (high schools,
community-based organizations)
Comfortable in a dynamic startup environment incl. significant
amounts of autonomy
Passionate about access, affordability, and equity in higher
education

Preferred Qualifications

Bi/multilingual, a plus
Knowledge of Oracle Cloud, People Soft, Salesforce, and/or
Slate CRM
Project management experience

BU Benefits and Perks

Please check out Butler’s
Total Rewards website to learn more about our benefit
offerings, which include:

Paid Time Off and Holidays :

20 days of paid time off (vacation and PTO days) per Fiscal
year
8 Paid Holidays

In addition, a paid Winter Break between Christmas Eve and New
Year’s Day


Paid Parental Leave (after 1 year of full-time employment)


Health :

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans including
disability and life insurance programs


Retirement :

10% employer contribution after 1 year of full-time
employment


Tuition Assistance :

Tuition Exchange Program for Dependents
Remission of tuition for classes taken at Butler for employees,
spouses, and dependent children.

Eligibility after 9 months of full-time employment
Employees & spouses- undergraduate/graduate degrees
Dependents (under age 26)- undergraduate degree
Covers tuition only




Butler Facilities Access, Discounts and Perks :

Access to Butler’s on-site fitness facility and libraries for
full-time staff and faculty
LinkedIn Learning Courses
Free premium subscription to the Calm App
Free subscription to the WSJ, The Economist, and NYT
Discount at the College Bookstore
Discount on select Athletic and Arts/Events Center
Performances



About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
